test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**intense**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a situation where companies hire workers 'flexibly' for short periods. This hiring practice is linked to the "______ pressure of work." The blank requires an adjective that describes a type of work pressure that would necessitate flexible or short-term hiring.
 
• "**intense**" means very great; very strong. Intense pressure of work would likely lead companies to hire workers for short periods to manage temporary surges in workload.
 
• Other options do not fit the context:
 
 
• "**inadequate**" means insufficient, which doesn't logically connect to hiring more workers for short periods.
 
• "**mechanical**" relates to machinery and is irrelevant to the pressure of work on employees.
 
• "**artificial**" means made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, which doesn't describe the nature of work pressure.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *In recent years, the central and state governments in India have been taking special steps to 1. attract__ foreign companies to invest in India. Industrial zones, called Special Economic Zones (SEZs), are being 2. __set up__. SEZs have world-class facilities, including electricity, water, roads, transport, storage, recreational, and educational facilities. Companies that set up production units in the SEZs do not have to pay taxes for an initial period of five years. The government has also 3. __introduced __flexibility in the labour laws to attract foreign investment. In recent years, the government has allowed companies to 4. __effect __many of these provisions. Instead of hiring workers on a regular basis, companies hire workers 'flexibly' for short periods when there is 5. __intense __pressure of work. This is done to reduce the cost of labour for the company. However, some foreign companies are not satisfied, and they are demanding more in labour laws, citing the need for greater operational efficiency.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Intense:** very great; very strong.
